question: What mitigations does ATT&CK list for T1047 (Windows Management Instrumentation)?

answer.headline: Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
answer.narrative: The Windows Management Instrumentation technique (T1047) is associated with four mitigations in MITRE ATT&CK. These include Execution Prevention (M1038), Behavior Prevention on Endpoint (M1040), User Account Management (M1018), and Privileged Account Management (M1026).
